results.title: Duct Tape
results.overview: Two boys are kidnapped and thrown into a room. How will they get out?

results.title: Rock Bottom
results.overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

results.title: Aladdin's Revenge
results.overview: After the events of the first films, Rachel, the lone survivor of Aladdin, finds the lamp once more haunting her as she attends a therapy retreat. She must protect a new set of friends as the lamp's evil plan to grant three deadly wishes begins all over again.

results.title: A Knight to Remember
results.overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

results.title: A Holandesinha
results.overview: “A Holandesinha” follows Luiza Godoi Acosta, a young woman with Down syndrome who dreams of becoming a filmmaker and sets out to create her first short film, "Lágrimas de um Pierrot". The documentary traces every stage of the creative process, revealing her worldview, the challenges she faces, and her triumphs over ableism. Produced in the countryside of Paraná, the film celebrates inclusion and affirms cinema as a space of possibility, belonging, and perseverance.

results.title: What's the Story, Wishbone?
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.

results.title: Vespers
results.overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

results.title: Watching People Watching Birds
results.overview: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

results.title: The Last Resort
results.overview: When a Danish family finds themselves on a holiday island, in the midst of the first major refugee crisis in Europe in our time, our northern European, well-intentioned, humanistic values are put to the test.

results.title: Wen er maar aan
results.overview: Actress M. is facing menopause, loses her long-running role in a crime series, has to deal with an apathetic teenage son, and her sex life is as dry as toast. She tries to reinvent herself, to prove to herself and to the world that she still has a future ahead of her.

results.title: Narciso
results.overview: Paraguay, 1958. The charismatic Narciso returns from Buenos Aires with rock ’n’ roll in his veins. Under the suffocating military regime, his radio show becomes a music sensation and a symbol of freedom.

results.title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 1
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on March 28, 2026, at Lily Arena Mito in Mito, Ibaraki, Japan.

results.title: I Come Home
results.overview: Christine attends her sister’s wedding with her two partners, Alex and Stephane. As the trio adjusts to their newly formed polyamorous relationship, Christine learns she is unexpectedly pregnant. The news sparks conflicting reactions and exposes tensions about commitment and the future. Surrounded by judgmental relatives and controlling parents, the wedding becomes a pressure cooker where private doubts and fragile dynamics surface. Over the course of the celebration, the three must confront what love, family, and responsibility mean for them.

results.title: Carefree Head
results.overview: Murat, who lives in Istanbul, decides to return to his hometown of Cappadocia after being fired from his job. As he plans to start a new business there, his path crosses with his cousins Bedri and Fehmi, who are trying to escape the consequences of a crime they committed. However, the carefree spirit wandering around the town will both prevent Bedri and Fehmi from escaping and support Murat in establishing his new venture.

results.title: Last Time
results.overview: In a Singapore that has transformed beyond recognition, three ordinary Singaporeans share memories of what came before. A cobbler in his eighties, a former draftswoman in her seventies and a secretary in her sixties recall childhoods shaped by hardship and scarce opportunity. As the city modernised, they share how technology played its part in their lives and in the society around them. Last Time is a tender reflection on progress, and what we leave behind.

results.title: Sommes-nous tous accros aux écrans ?
results.overview: Screen addiction is a growing public health concern. From social media algorithms to video games and AI, digital platforms exploit human psychology to influence our behavior. But what makes our brains so susceptible, and why does this dependency affect all generations?

results.title: A Royal Setting
results.overview: Ruby, a world-renowned gemologist, is hired by Prince Luca to restore the crown jewels and design his crown, challenging tradition and complicating his relationship with his mother, the queen.

results.title: Somebody's Watching Me
results.overview: After a friend's bachelorette weekend, Lori receives a flash drive with footage from a hidden camera at their Airbnb. The footage is of her sleeping and then a masked stranger entering the room and watching her.

results.title: Scissors
results.overview: A slasher with a grudge meets his match when a group of queer friends on a weekend getaway turns his killing spree into a bloody night he never saw coming.
